findings.claim: FY2025 三家經銷商各占營收 10% 以上：Distributor A 28%（2024: 29%）、B 15%（15%）、C 12%（13%），合計約 55%；應收帳款占比 A 32%、B 12%、C 9%
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Note 15 Segment Information
findings.excerpt: The following distributor customers accounted for 10% or more of our revenue: Year Ended December 31, 2025 2024 2023 Distributor A 28 % 29 % 28 % Distributor B 15 % 15 % 15 % Distributor C 12 % 13 % 13 %

findings.claim: 六家直接購買的經銷商占 2025 年底應收帳款 67%（2024: 69%）；公司風險因子自述最大經銷商可能遇財務困難而影響收款
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: Six distributor customers who purchase directly from us accounted for 67% and 69% of our total net accounts receivable in the aggregate as of December 31, 2025 and 2024, respectively.

findings.claim: 經搜尋未找到經銷商信用評等調降、破產或財務壓力的來源

note: 終端客戶分散於 100+ 國；集中在經銷商層。經銷商財務惡化事件搜尋無所獲。
